newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 27.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Wednesday:
- Pearson Plc's Penguin Group plans to buy Putnam Berkley Group of MCA Inc of Seagram Co Ltd for $336 million in cash.
- Bell Atlantic Corp will take management control of cellular phone company Grupo Iusacell SA de CV in Mexico.
- IBM Corp will spend an extra $3.5 billion to buy its own shares on the open market.
- Japanese investors are increasingly reluctant to invest overseas.
- Cash flows into stock funds in November were well ahead of last month's flows.
- Prices of Treasury securities ended mixed due to late profit taking.
- Walt Disney Co reported a 27-percent rise in fourth-quarter profit to $336 million.
- Disney will release a film on the life of the Dalai Lama despite objections from China.
- Primark Corp is expected to announce it has acquired Baseline Financial Services for $40 million in cash from Bowne & Co Inc and Robert Patterson.
- Hughes Electronics Corp has signed up to launch commercial satellites on a Japanese rocket.
- Chiron Corp stock fell after its new herpes vaccine failed a clinical test.
- PepsiCo Inc has joined Microsoft Corp in a $20 million holiday promotional campaign.
